CATALOG.label: Buy-box competition
CATALOG.description: Multiple sellers compete for one product's featured offer. The winner is the best composite of price, fulfilment speed and seller trust — each weight is tunable here.

recompute_on_change.label: Recompute the winner when an offer or health row changes

CATALOG.label: Seller account health
CATALOG.description: Account health: defect, cancellation and late-shipment rates roll into a score that decides the tier and suspension.

suspend_below.label: Health score below which a seller's offers are suspended

late_shipment_days.label: A shipment is 'late' after this many days undelivered

CATALOG.label: Buyer protection (A-to-z)
CATALOG.description: A buyer may raise a claim against a seller; a claim resolved in the buyer's favour credits the buyer from the ledger.

auto_dispute_escrow.label: Mark an order's escrow hold disputed while a claim is open

refund_kind.label: Wallet ledger kind used for a buyer-favour refund

CATALOG.label: Smart-fulfilment grading
CATALOG.description: Fulfilment grading: each grade carries a dispatch SLA in hours.

CATALOG.label: Fulfilment-centre inbound
CATALOG.description: Sellers ship units to a fulfilment centre; receiving closes the inbound and adds the units to FC inventory.

default_status.label: Initial status of an inbound shipment

CATALOG.label: UPI collect
CATALOG.description: Raise a collect request against a payer VPA; settlement credits the single wallet ledger.

new_handle_status.label: Status of a freshly added VPA

collect_expiry_hours.label: A collect request expires after this many hours

min_amount.label: Lowest collectable amount (0 disables the floor)

CATALOG.label: QR scan-pay
CATALOG.description: Issue QR records from the registry's kinds; a scan is counted and (optionally) a payment completed.

default_kind.label: QR kind when none is supplied

CATALOG.label: Payment links
CATALOG.description: Issue a tokenised link that credits the owner's wallet when paid. Single-use by default.

expiry_days.label: A link is payable for this many days

single_use.label: A paid link cannot be paid again

CATALOG.label: Mandates / auto-debit
CATALOG.description: Register an auto-debit mandate and charge it up to its cap. Subscriptions ride on this.

recharge_window_days.label: Days added to the next-charge-at on each charge

CATALOG.label: Escrow hold & release
CATALOG.description: Hold funds at order time and release to the seller only on confirmation. Trade assurance composes this capability.

dispute_freezes.label: A dispute prevents release until resolved

release_kind.label: Wallet ledger kind used for a seller release

CATALOG.label: Split payments
CATALOG.description: Divide a payment across parties at order time. The parts must sum to the total, or the ledger would drift.

tolerance.label: Rounding tolerance when comparing the split sum with the total

settle_immediately.label: Settle the parts when the payment lands

CATALOG.label: KYC verification
CATALOG.description: Identity verification that gates credit: BNPL and loans require the full tier.

full_tier_status.label: KYC profile status that satisfies the full tier

CATALOG.label: Buy-now-pay-later
CATALOG.description: A KYC-gated credit account that generates an EMI schedule on each spend.

CATALOG.label: Loans & credit lines
CATALOG.description: Apply, approve and disburse credit. The EMI is computed from the principal, tenure and rate.

default_rate_pct.label: Annual rate when none is supplied (0 = flat)

CATALOG.label: Bank payouts
CATALOG.description: Queue a payout to a bank account or VPA and process it through the configured gateway.

default_status.label: Initial status of a queued payout

CATALOG.label: Bill payments (BBPS)
CATALOG.description: Pay electricity, water, gas and similar bills through registered billers.

default_category.label: Category when the biller is unknown

CATALOG.label: Mobile / DTH recharge
CATALOG.description: Prepaid recharge against a plan catalogue; a recharge debits the wallet on success.

default_kind.label: Recharge kind when none is supplied

CATALOG.label: P2P wallet transfer
CATALOG.description: Wallet-to-wallet transfer between two owners. Self-transfer and overdraft are refused.

ledger_unit.label: Unit the transfer row is written in

CATALOG.label: Insurance distribution
CATALOG.description: Quote a policy and activate it; activation debits the premium from the wallet.

activation_debits_premium.label: Activating a policy charges the premium

CATALOG.label: Gift vouchers
CATALOG.description: Issue a code with a balance; redemption credits the holder's wallet. Expired codes are retired on use.

code_length.label: Length of the generated voucher code

CATALOG.label: Instant / quick-commerce delivery
CATALOG.description: Dark stores, serviceability, delivery slots and proof-of-delivery OTP. The promise is the store's own advertised minutes plus prep time.

default_promise_minutes.label: Promise minutes a store advertises when unset

default_prep_minutes.label: Prep minutes added to every promise

default_radius_km.label: Service radius for geo resolution when unset

promise_includes_prep.label: The shown promise is store minutes + prep

CATALOG.label: Store-inventory pinning
CATALOG.description: Per-store stock pinning so a dark store cannot oversell. Safety stock is held back from the sellable count.

reserve_at_pin.label: Reserve the units when a cart is pinned to a store

consume_on_delivery.label: Decrement the store's qty when a run is delivered

CATALOG.label: Dispatch batching & PoD
CATALOG.description: Batch orders onto one rider for one slot and close delivery with an OTP handshake.

release_slot_on_delivery.label: Return the slot seat when the run closes

rider_goes_online_after.label: A rider returns to online after delivering

CATALOG.label: Trade assurance
CATALOG.description: Order-level escrow with milestones: funds release to the seller only when the buyer confirms receipt.

assurance_fee_pct.label: Assurance fee as a fraction of the order (0.02 = 2%)

default_milestones.label: Milestone sequence when none is supplied

CATALOG.label: Gold-supplier membership
CATALOG.description: Paid supplier memberships with a verification level that drives storefront badges.

CATALOG.label: Company verification audit
CATALOG.description: An audit of a supplier's identity and export record; approval stamps badges and activates the membership.

approval_activates_membership.label: An approved audit marks the supplier's gold membership verified

CATALOG.label: Export / customs documents
CATALOG.description: Generate commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading and certificates deterministically from the order's own fields.

default_doc_kind.label: Document kind when none is supplied

default_origin.label: Origin country when none is supplied

CATALOG.label: Letters of credit
CATALOG.description: Issue, present and settle an LC. A clean presentation pays; a discrepant one is recorded, not thrown.

presentable_statuses.label: LC statuses from which a presentation is allowed

CATALOG.label: RFQ multi-seller bidding
CATALOG.description: Suppliers quote against a buyer's RFQ; quotes rank by unit price then lead time. Accepting one closes the rest.

rank_by.label: Columns the ranking orders by, ascending

default_validity_days.label: Quote validity when none is supplied

CATALOG.label: Tender reverse auction
CATALOG.description: Open tenders take sealed bids and rank them lowest-first; awarding rejects every other bid.

mirror_to_tender_column.label: Keep the legacy tenders.bids column in sync for the existing console

CATALOG.label: Segment price lists
CATALOG.description: Per-segment prices with quantity tiers; the storefront resolves the buyer's segment and reads the override.

best_price_wins.label: When several tiers fit, the lowest price wins

CATALOG.label: MOQ enforcement
CATALOG.description: The cart must respect each line's minimum order quantity — from the product, the supplier link or the price list.

default_moq.label: MOQ when no source declares one

CATALOG.label: Product reviews
CATALOG.description: Shopper-written product reviews with ratings, replies and moderation.

moderation.label: A review is published only after a moderator approves it

CATALOG.label: Questions & Answers
CATALOG.description: Shoppers ask and answer questions on a product page.

buyer_answers.label: Other shoppers may answer a question, not only staff

CATALOG.label: Deals page & strip
CATALOG.description: The /deals page, the header deal link and the storefront offers strip.

CATALOG.label: Promo codes
CATALOG.description: Shopper-redeemable coupon codes at cart and checkout. Platform policy may refuse this independently.
CATALOG.policy_message: Coupons are disabled by platform policy (Platform → Provisioning)

CATALOG.label: Gift cards & balance
CATALOG.description: The gift-cards page, the gift-balance line in checkout and the wallet top-up path.

CATALOG.label: Registries
CATALOG.description: Wish-list style product registries a shopper shares by link.

CATALOG.label: Client care
CATALOG.description: The customer-service page and the shopper-facing contact channel.

CATALOG.label: Save for later
CATALOG.description: Moving a cart line to a saved list and back.

CATALOG.label: Deal countdown
CATALOG.description: A live countdown badge on time-limited offers.

CATALOG.label: Search suggestions
CATALOG.description: Type-ahead suggestions on the storefront search box.

CATALOG.label: Buy now
CATALOG.description: Skip the cart: a product's Buy Now goes straight to checkout.

CATALOG.label: Fiscal context picker
CATALOG.description: Customer-facing selection of a tax/invoice context at checkout. Platform policy may refuse this independently.
CATALOG.policy_message: Customer-facing fiscal context selection is disabled by platform policy

CATALOG.label: Subscribe & Save
CATALOG.description: Recurring purchase schedules with a discount and a cadence.

discount_pct.label: Default discount for a scheduled purchase

CATALOG.label: Membership program
CATALOG.description: Paid or free tiers with perks applied at checkout (free shipping, bonus credit).

bonus_pct.label: Checkout bonus credit a member earns

CATALOG.label: Risk screening
CATALOG.description: Order-time risk screening that may flag or block a suspicious order.

block_above.label: A risk score above this blocks the order

CATALOG.label: Experiments
CATALOG.description: A/B experiment assignment for storefront surfaces.

CATALOG.label: Supply-chain planning
CATALOG.description: Purchase suggestions, replenishment and demand planning for the store's buyers.

CATALOG.label: Admin portal link
CATALOG.description: The 'Admin Console' link shown to a store's own staff on the storefront.

CATALOG.label: Ride hailing
CATALOG.description: The ride lifecycle: request → accept → arrive → trip start → complete/cancel, with fare construction and per-state cancellation fees.

min_fare.label: Floor below which a completed fare is not charged

booking_fee.label: Fixed platform booking fee added to every fare

platform_take_rate_pct.label: Platform commission on a driver's fare

cancel_fee_accepted.label: Cancellation fee once a driver accepted

cancel_fee_midtrip.label: Cancellation fee once the trip started

CATALOG.label: Surge / dynamic pricing
CATALOG.description: A multiplier raised by active surge zones and by the live demand/supply ratio, capped by configuration.

surge_cap_multiplier.label: The multiplier is never raised above this ceiling

demand_supply_enabled.label: Raise the multiplier from the live open-rides / idle-drivers ratio

demand_supply_step.label: Each whole step of ratio above 1 adds one increment

demand_supply_max_ratio.label: The ratio assumed when no driver is idle

CATALOG.label: Dispatch & matching
CATALOG.description: Match a request to the nearest idle driver of the requested kind, with a search radius, ETA construction and auto-dispatch.

auto_dispatch.label: Assign a driver automatically on request (off = a manual dispatcher works the queue)

match_radius_km.label: Maximum distance a candidate driver may be

eta_per_km_minutes.label: ETA minutes per km of approach distance

eta_pickup_buffer_minutes.label: Flat minutes added to every ETA

unknown_position_penalty_km.label: Distance assumed for a driver with no last-known position

city_centre_offset_km.label: Subtracted from a driver's stored city distance

CATALOG.label: Fleet & driver management
CATALOG.description: Drivers and vehicles: onboarding, online/offline state, vehicle kinds, maintenance state and the health that dispatch ranks on.

min_rating_to_dispatch.label: A driver below this rating is held out of dispatch

CATALOG.label: HRMS & payroll
CATALOG.description: Employees, attendance and the payroll run: base + overtime + allowances, less configured deductions and tax, pro-rated by worked days.

overtime_multiplier.label: Overtime pay multiple of the hourly rate

allowance_amount.label: Flat allowance added to every payslip

deduction_pct.label: Deduction as a fraction of gross

tax_rate_pct.label: Tax applied to the taxable amount

CATALOG.label: Procurement & SCM
CATALOG.description: Purchase requests with lines and an approval gate: below the threshold a request self-approves, above it a sign-off is required before the status can advance.

approval_threshold.label: A request costing more than this needs an approval row (0 = no gate)

default_currency.label: Currency a purchase request is estimated in

CATALOG.label: Manufacturing
CATALOG.description: Work orders consuming a bill of materials, completing at a configured yield with a configured scrap loss, and posting the finished good to inventory.

yield_pct.label: Good units as a share of the run

backflush.label: Consume the BOM components on completion rather than on release

CATALOG.label: Projects & approvals
CATALOG.description: Projects, tasks and time-logging that accrues to a project's spend at a configured internal cost rate, plus the approval chain gating operational actions.

internal_cost_per_hour.label: Cost rate applied to logged hours (0 = time is free)

approval_levels.label: Sign-off levels an approval passes through

CATALOG.label: Wish lists
CATALOG.description: Shoppers keep named lists of products — private, shared by link or public. What a kind of list is and what each visibility means are registry rows (listKinds, listVisibilities).

allow_sharing.label: Shoppers may share a list by link

allow_public.label: Shoppers may make a list public

CATALOG.label: Price & stock alerts
CATALOG.description: A shopper watches a product and is told when its price drops, reaches their target, or it is back in stock. Each kind of alert is an alertKinds row naming its trigger and its message.

max_watches.label: Active alerts one shopper may keep

cooldown_hours.label: Hours before one alert may fire again

rearm.label: A fired alert keeps watching from the new price

CATALOG.label: Pickup points & lockers
CATALOG.description: Shoppers choose a locker, counter or store at checkout instead of a home address and collect with a one-time code. The kinds of point are pickupKinds rows; holding time, fee and code length are tuned here.

free_shipping_applies.label: Free-shipping rules also waive the pickup fee

hold_days.label: Days a parcel waits once it is ready

max_attempts.label: Wrong codes before a parcel locks

default_eta_days.label: Days to reach a point that sets none

email_on_ready.label: Email the shopper when the parcel is ready

notify_kind.label: Notification kind sent when a parcel is ready

CATALOG.label: Rich product content
CATALOG.description: Brand-authored modules (banners, image-and-text, feature lists, comparison tables, Q&A) below the product details. Module kinds and their fields are contentModules rows; content can be reviewed before it goes live.

require_approval.label: Content is reviewed before it goes live

brand_owner_only.label: Only the brand's registered owner may publish

CATALOG.label: Brand registry
CATALOG.description: A seller proves it owns a brand; once approved it may report counterfeit or infringing offers, which staff uphold or dismiss. Upholding moves the offending offer to the offer state named here.

require_trademark.label: A claim must carry a trademark number

one_owner_per_brand.label: A brand has at most one approved owner

offer_state_on_infringement.label: Offer state an upheld report moves the offer to

badge.label: Show a registered-brand badge on product pages

CATALOG.label: Sponsored products
CATALOG.description: Sellers' ads compete in a second-price auction for slots in search results and other surfaces, targeted by keyword and paid per click, thousand impressions or sale. Budgets and schedules are enforced.

reserve_price.label: Lowest bid that may serve (per charged unit)

pctr_baseline.label: Predicted click rate of a new ad

pctr_spend_lift.label: Most an ad's past spend can add to its predicted click rate

spend_divisor.label: Past spend is divided by this and added to the predicted click rate (up to the lift)

runner_up_factor.label: Share of its own score the last ad pays when no one bids below it

enforce_budget.label: An ad stops serving once it has spent its budget

enforce_schedule.label: An ad serves only between its start and end

record_impressions.label: Serving an ad records an impression (charged under per-thousand bidding)

impression_event.label: Ad event recorded when an ad is served (an adEventKinds row)

CATALOG.label: Product options
CATALOG.description: Modifiers, add-ons and personalisation: option groups defined once, attached to any product, each value with its own price change. What a kind of group does is an optionKinds row.

max_text_length.label: Longest personal text a shopper may enter

CATALOG.label: Bookings
CATALOG.description: Appointments, stays, rentals and experiences: resources with weekly hours in their own time zone and a capacity; a shopper holds a time, pays for it, and staff check them in. Modes and resource kinds are registry rows.

hold_minutes.label: Minutes a chosen time is held while the shopper checks out

cancel_cutoff_hours.label: Hours before the start a shopper may still cancel

max_horizon_days.label: Furthest ahead anything may be booked

CATALOG.label: Make an offer
CATALOG.description: A shopper offers a price; the seller accepts, counters or declines; an agreed price is bought within a window. Thresholds can accept or decline automatically.

min_offer_pct.label: Lowest offer, as a share of the list price

auto_accept_pct.label: Offers at or above this share are accepted at once (0 = never)

auto_decline_pct.label: Offers below this share are declined at once (0 = never)

expiry_hours.label: Hours an offer or counter stays open

buy_within_hours.label: Hours to buy at an agreed price

max_open_per_shopper.label: Open offers one shopper may have

CATALOG.label: Auctions
CATALOG.description: Timed auctions with automatic (proxy) bidding, a reserve, a buy-it-now price and protection against last-second bids; the winner pays within a window.

anti_snipe_minutes.label: A bid this close to the end extends the auction

extend_minutes.label: Minutes an auction is extended by

payment_window_hours.label: Hours the winner has to pay

CATALOG.label: Shopper selling
CATALOG.description: Any signed-in shopper lists their own items — used, refurbished or new — reviewed before they go on sale; the store keeps a commission and credits the rest after a holding period.

require_review.label: Listings are reviewed before they go on sale

hold_days.label: Days a sale's proceeds are held before they are credited

max_live.label: Listings one shopper may have on sale

seller_role.label: Seller role a shopper is registered under (a sellerRoles row)

source_kind.label: Product source recorded for a listed item

earnings_kind.label: Wallet ledger kind used to credit proceeds

CATALOG.label: Buyer–seller messages
CATALOG.description: Conversations between a shopper and whoever sells a product, an order or a booking — the store or another shopper. What a conversation may be about is a conversationSubjects row; staff can review and flag.

hide_contact_details.label: Hide email addresses and phone numbers in messages

CATALOG.label: Group buying
CATALOG.description: A lower price that applies when enough shoppers join before a deadline; if the group falls short, every member's order is cancelled and refunded.

close_when_full.label: A campaign closes as soon as it is full

refund_kind.label: Wallet ledger kind used to refund a failed group

CATALOG.label: Substitutions
CATALOG.description: When an item is unavailable at picking: the shopper's own choice per line — refund, best match, ask me, or a named item — and the picker's proposal; a cheaper substitute refunds the difference. Policies are substitutionPolicies rows.

charge_more.label: Charge the shopper when a substitute costs more

refund_kind.label: Wallet ledger kind used for a refunded difference

PRESETS.label: Marketplace blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: multi-seller competition with buyer protection and trade assurance — the composition a marketplace operator would recognise.

PRESETS.label: Quick-commerce blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: dark stores, a minutes-level promise, OTP proof-of-delivery and wallet rails — the composition a quick-commerce operator would recognise.

PRESETS.label: B2B trade blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: assurance escrow, memberships, verification audits, export documents, LCs and RFQ bidding — the composition a B2B-trade operator would recognise.

PRESETS.label: Fintech rails blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: the full money rail set — UPI, QR, links, mandates, escrow, splits, KYC, payouts, BBPS, recharge, BNPL, lending, insurance and vouchers.

PRESETS.label: Mixed commerce blend
PRESETS.description: Proof of composition: marketplace buy-box and buyer protection, quick-commerce dispatch and store pinning, and UPI rails from fintech — none of which comes from one vendor.

PRESETS.label: Mobility blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: ride hailing with surge pricing, nearest-driver dispatch and a fleet registry — the composition a ride-hailing or delivery operator would recognise.

PRESETS.label: Everything-store blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: a multi-seller marketplace with the full shopper storefront — reviews, Q&A, deals with countdowns, promo codes, gift cards, registries, subscribe & save, a membership with free shipping, buy-now, save-for-later, risk screening — over fulfilment-centre inbound, seller payouts and pay-later credit.

PRESETS.label: Operations blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: HRMS and payroll, procurement with an approval gate, manufacturing with yield and scrap, and projects with an approval chain — the composition an ERP operator would recognise.

PRESETS.label: Omnichannel retail blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: a retail chain selling online and through its shops — store stock, pickup at a shop or locker, fast local delivery, substitutions, memberships and repeat orders.

PRESETS.label: Payments-led super app blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: a wallet and payments app that also sells — UPI and QR payments, bill payments, recharges, pay later and lending, beside a marketplace and fast delivery.

PRESETS.label: Resale and classifieds blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: shoppers sell to shoppers — their own listings, offers and counter-offers, auctions, messages between buyer and seller, escrow and buyer protection.

PRESETS.label: Auction house blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: timed auctions with automatic bidding, reserves and buy-it-now, buyer messages, escrow and buyer protection.

PRESETS.label: Services and appointments blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: appointments with staff, rooms or venues — held while the customer pays, checked in on the day — with options, messages and memberships.

PRESETS.label: Rentals and stays blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: date-range bookings of assets, rooms or venues with escrow, buyer protection, messages and reviews.

PRESETS.label: Food and restaurant delivery blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: restaurant menus with modifiers and add-ons, minutes-fast delivery, batched dispatch, reviews and memberships.

PRESETS.label: Social and group buying blend
PRESETS.description: A worked example: group prices that unlock when enough shoppers join, flash deals with countdowns, coupons and shareable lists.
